name: Search and Inspect Repositories
description: Search GitHub repositories and fetch detailed information. Handles the search+detail pattern: finds repos matching a query, then fetches full metadata including languages, topics, and recent commits.

query.description: Search query using GitHub search syntax (e.g., 'language:typescript stars:>100', 'org:withoneai')

sort.description: Sort by: stars, forks, help-wanted-issues, updated, or best-match

includeCommits.description: Fetch recent commits for each repo (adds one API call per repo)

steps.name: Fetch additional details for each repo
